Submission Instructions

  1. Construct a valid IIIF 3.0 JSON-LD manifest (manifest.json) defining two Canvases for recto and verso of your assigned manuscript leaf.
  2. Extract image coordinates for three distinct textual lines (using pixel coordinates x,y,w,h).
  3. Write a TEI <facsimile> block containing <surface> and <zone> elements linked to your TEI <text> lines using @facs.
  4. Verify your manifest in the online IIIF Manifest Validator and load it into Mirador.
  5. Submit your JSON manifest, TEI snippet, and a 300–500 word reflection on how IIIF decouples image hosting from scholarly annotation architectures.
